# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

cran <- c("parallel", "sommer")
git <- c("hemstrow/snpR") # https://github.com/hemstrow/snpR

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  for (pkg in cran) { 
    if( !require(pkg, character.only = TRUE) ) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } 
  }
  
  for (pkg in git) {
    if( !require(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE) ) {
      devtools::install_github(pkg, upgrade = TRUE)
      library(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}); remove(cran, git, pkg)

# remotes::install_github("hemstrow/snpR", ref = "dev")

ncores <- floor(parallel::detectCores()*0.8)
set.seed(2025)

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

cat("Project: ", getwd(), "\n")
session_info()
```

For the large files was created a `xclude` folder and add the name to the `.gitignore` to avoid upload files saved in this folder to the server

# Phenotypic data

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WQKAOnxO9on7YoF9yC2WV7eHcChZJ5FR6DVyg0tJK1o/edit#gid=0"
gs <- url %>% as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("phenotype") %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(trial, pop, num, type, rlw_flw:w2l_mtr)) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(line
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("cross", "nline")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       , too_few = "align_start"
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "SALx", ) ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "xKAN", ) ~ "KAN"
    , .default = cross
  ), .before = "cross")
  

fb %>% web_table(caption = "Phenotypic data")
```

```{r}
fbdist <- fb %>% 
  drop_na(nline) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(pop:line), names_to = "trait") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(trait
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("variable", "phenology")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(phenology = case_when(
    phenology %in% "flw" ~ "flowering" 
    , phenology %in% "mtr" ~ "maturity"
    , phenology %in% "hrv" ~ "harvest"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable %in% "ndflw" ~ "Flowering (days)" 
    , variable %in% "plth" ~ "Plant height (cm)"
    , variable %in% "pnlg" ~ "Panicle lenght (cm)"
    , variable %in% "pnwd" ~ "Panicle width (cm)"
    , variable %in% "mstd" ~ "Mean stem diameter (cm)"
    , variable %in% "ndpm" ~ "Physiological maturity (days)"
    , variable %in% "sdyp" ~ "Yield by plant (g)"
    , variable %in% "yplt" ~ "Yield by 10 plants (g)"
    , variable %in% "yield" ~ "Yield (Tn/ha)"
  )) %>% 
  unite("label", c(variable, phenology), sep = "\nStage: ", remove = F)

fbdist$trait %>% unique() %>% dput()

order <- c("ndflw_flw"
           , "plth_flw"
           , "pnlg_flw", "pnwd_flw"
           , "ndpm_mtr"
           , "plth_mtr"
           , "pnlg_mtr", "pnwd_mtr"
           , "mstd_mtr"
           , "sdyp_hrv", "yplt_hrv", "yield_hrv")

lb <- fbdist %>% 
  dplyr::select(trait, label) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  deframe()

dist <- fbdist %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = order)) %>% 
  arrange(trait) %>% 
  plot_raw(type = "box"
         , x = "pop"
         , y = "value"
         , legend = "none"
         , xlab = "Population"
         , ylab = ""
           ) +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free_y"
             , labeller = as_labeller(lb)
             , nrow = 3
             ) + 
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1)

dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL
dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL

fig <- dist %>% 
  ggsave2(filename = "manuscript/SFigure-02.jpg"
          , units = "cm", width = 30, height = 15)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

# Genotypic data

Genotypic data is in a BCF file which has more than 2 Gb large and harbors >900.000 SNPs. In order to keep the running times manageable, the number of SNPs has to be reduce.

The snp pruning were performed in the server of the Crop Biodiversity and Breeding Informatics groups at University of Hohenheim.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

ssh flaaw57@server231.ipsp.uni-hohenheim.de
cd /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/
cd /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/

# -e stands for "exclude." It removes variants that meet the specified condition.
# F_MISSING refers to the fraction of missing data at a variant site.
# > 0.5 means any variants where more than 50% of the data are missing will be excluded (filtered out).

bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' -O z /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/quinoa_run1_all.bcf > /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/quinoa.vcf.gz

# export names to rename
bcftools query -l quinoa.vcf.gz > genotype_names.txt
```

## Genotypes names to rename vcf file

```{r}
#| eval: false

vcf.names <- "genetics/genotype_names.txt" %>% 
  read.csv(header = F, col.names = "name_old") %>% 
  mutate(pmatch = toupper(name_old)) %>% 
  mutate(match = gsub(".*A(.+)_F.*", "\\1", pmatch)) %>% 
  select(!pmatch)

parents <- c("blanca de juli" = "BDJ"
             , "chulpi" = "CHU"
             , "ayrampo" = "AYR"
             , "choclito" = "CHO")

geno.names <- "genetics/camacani_plots_cs-genotyping.xlsx" %>% 
  readxl::read_xlsx() %>% 
  mutate(cross = recode(cross, !!!parents)) %>% 
  unite(match, c(plots, crossn, line), remove = F, sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    cross %in% c("SAL", "PAN", "HUA", "KCA", "COL", "BDJ", "CHU", "AYR", "CHO", "PAS") ~  as.character(paste(cross, line, crossn, sep = "_"))
    , TRUE ~ as.character(paste(cross, line, sep = "_"))
  )) %>% 
  select(match, name_new) 

vcf.rename <- merge(vcf.names, geno.names, by = "match", all.x = T) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    is.na(name_new) ~ name_old
    , TRUE ~ name_new
  )) %>% 
  select(!match) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("KCA", "KAN", name_new)) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("COL", "NCO", name_new))

tab <- vcf.rename %>% 
  distinct(name_new) 

vcf.rename %>% write_tsv("genetics/vcf.rename.txt")
```

## Filter by Population

```{bash}
#| eval: false

bcftools query -l quinoa_rhd.vcf.gz > genotype_renamed.txt

# Filter NAM populations for SAL and KAN

grep -E "SALx|xKAN" genotype_renamed.txt > populations.txt
cat populations.txt

# SNPs for all populations

bcftools view -S populations.txt quinoa_rhd.vcf.gz > quinoa_pops.vcf.gz
```

# snpR

- https://www.nature.com/articles/s41576-024-00738-6/tables/1

```{r}
# vcffile <- choose.files()

vcfile <- "G:/Mi unidad/coding/quinoa4gwas/quinoa_pops.vcf.gz"

snpdt <- snpR::read_vcf(file = vcfile)
snpdt

sample_meta <- snpdt %>% 
  names() %>% 
  gsub("_.*", "", .) %>% 
  enframe(value = "cross") %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "xKAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "KAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "SALx") ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "SAL") ~ "SAL"
  ))
  
sample.meta(snpdt)$cross <- factor(sample_meta$cross
                                   , levels = c("HUAxKAN", "NCOxKAN", "PASxKAN"
                                                , "SALxHUA", "SALxNCO", "SALxPAN"))
sample.meta(snpdt)$pop <- sample_meta$pop

sample.meta(snpdt)
snp.meta(snpdt)
```

# Clean genotyping data

```{r}
# Minor allele frequency of 0.05
# Minimum individuals 50%
# At least 50% of loci sequenced per individual.

snpdt_filt <- snpR::filter_snps(x = snpdt
                              , maf = 0.05
                              , min_ind = 0.5
                              , min_loci = 0.3
                              , maf_facets = "cross"
                              )

snpR::filters(snpdt_filt)
```

# Export data

```{r}
sample.meta(snpdt_filt)
snp.meta(snpdt_filt)

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt_filt
                     , output = "vcf"
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , facets = "pop"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     , outfile = "genetics/pops/nam"
                     )

snpR::citations(snpdt_filt)
snpR::filters(snpdt_filt)

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt_filt
                     , output = "vcf"
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     , outfile = "genetics/pops/quinoa.vcf"
                     )
```

# Objectives

## (i) Assess the inter and intra-population genetic differentiation of the NAM populations

- Fig 1: (a) PCA, (b) POPstructure, (c) FST,  and (d) LD by NAM pop
- Table with diversity value for NAM pop

### PCA

```{r}
pca <- plot_clusters(snpdt_filt, facets = c("pop.cross")
                     , check_duplicates = TRUE
                     , plot_type = "pca"
                     , shape_has_more_levels = FALSE 
                     )

paleta <- c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02")

p1a <- pca$plots$pca +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pop, color = cross), size = 1.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("KAN" = 16, "SAL" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = paleta) +
  labs(
    color = "Cross",
    shape = "Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1a
```

### Population structure

```{r}
#| cache: true

popstr_k <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 2:10
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , reps = 20
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , clumpp_path = "C:/CLUMPP/CLUMPP.exe"
                               )

plot_sfa <- popstr_k$plot

# Calcular la entropía cruzada promedio y desviación estándar por cada K
k_summary <- popstr_k$K_plot %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_entropy = mean(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_entropy = sd(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Visualizar la curva de entropía cruzada
plot_sfb <- ggplot(k_summary, aes(x = k, y = mean_entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Optimal K value selection with sNMF",
    x = "Number of clusters (K)",
    y = "Mean cross-entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_summary$k) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

list(plot_sfa + 
       scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Paired") + 
       theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
      )
     , plot_sfb 
     ) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.3)) %>% 
  ggsave2(plot = ., "manuscript/SFigure-01.jpg"
                 , width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm")

popstr <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 3
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , reps = 1
                               )

p1b <- popstr$plot +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qua", palette = "Accent")

p1b
```

### LD decay

```{bash}
VCF=genetics/pops/nam_KAN.vcf
RSL=genetics/pops/ld_results_KAN

plink1 --vcf $VCF --r2 --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-kb 300 --ld-window-r2 0 --allow-extra-chr --out $RSL

VCF=genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf
RSL=genetics/pops/ld_results_SAL

plink1 --vcf $VCF --r2 --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-kb 300 --ld-window-r2 0 --allow-extra-chr --out $RSL
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Cargar los datos y calcular distancia
ld_data_KAN <- read.table("genetics/pops/ld_results_KAN.ld", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(pop = "KAN") 
ld_data_SAL <- read.table("genetics/pops/ld_results_SAL.ld", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(pop = "SAL")

ld_data <- list(ld_data_KAN, ld_data_SAL) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(distance_kb = abs(BP_A - BP_B) / 1000)

# Filtrar a 300 kb
ld_data <- ld_data %>% 
  group_by(pop) %>% 
  filter(distance_kb <= 300)

ggplot(ld_data, aes(x = distance_kb, y = R2, color = pop)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.1, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Pairwise distance (kb)",
    y = expression(LD~(r^2))
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## (ii) Map and characterize QTL to elucidate their roles in yield architecture and cross-reference them with prior genomic findings in quinoa

> rMVP: Memory-efficient, Visualization-enhanced, and Parallel-accelerated Genome-Wide Association Study

- https://github.com/xiaolei-lab/rMVP
- https://github.com/YinLiLin/CMplot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NAM)
library(vcfR)
library(CMplot)
library(rMVP)
```

### SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line)) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(pop, cross, nline)) %>%
  write_csv("genetics//mlt-sal.csv")

MVP.Data(fileVCF = "genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf"
         , filePhe = "genetics/mlt-sal.csv"
         , sep.phe = ","
         , priority = "speed"
         , fileKin = FALSE
         , filePC = FALSE
         , out = "genetics/rmvp/dt_sal"
         , ncpus = ncores
         )
```

## Kinship

```{r}
MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE
             , mvp_prefix = 'genetics/rmvp/dt_sal'
             , out = 'genetics/rmvp/kin_sal')
```

## Data input

```{r}
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.desc")
phenotype <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.phe", head = TRUE)
mapping <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/kin_sal.kin.desc")
```

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "genetics/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_sal <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, REF, ALT)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-SAL", .))
```

## Kinship

```{r}
MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE

             , out = 'genetics/rmvp/kin_kan')
```

## Data input

```{r}
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.geno.desc")
phenotype <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.phe", head = TRUE)
mapping <- read.table("genetics/rmvp/dt_kan.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("genetics/rmvp/kin_kan.kin.desc")
```

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "genetics/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
    
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_kan <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, REF, ALT)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-KAN", .))
```

## Merge GWAS NAM populations

```{r}
gwas_rmvp <- base::merge(x = gwas_sal, y = gwas_kan
                  , by = c("SNP", "CHROM", "POS")
                  ) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM)

qtl <- gwas_rmvp %>% 
  dplyr::select(!contains("MAF")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(1:POS)) %>% 
  separate(name, c("Trait", "Population"), sep = "-") %>% 
  arrange(Trait, Population) %>% 
  mutate(log10 = round(-log10(value), 2)) %>% 
  filter(log10 >= 4)

qtl %>% kable()

# qtl %>% dplyr::select(!value) %>% write_sheet(ss = gs, sheet = "snps")
```

## SNP density-plot


# NAM: Nested Association Mapping

- https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/NAM/index.html

## SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line))

vcfdt  <- "genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf" %>% 
  vcfR::read.vcfR()

info <- vcfdt %>% 
  vcfR::getFIX() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(ID, ~ gsub("_", "",. ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column()

chr <- info %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(chrome = gsub(".*([0-9]+[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", CHROM)) %>% 
  group_by(chrome) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "rowname", values_from = "col") %>% 
  separate(geno, c("family", "line"), remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!line) %>% 
  mutate(fam = case_when(
    family %in% "SALxPAN" ~ 1
    , family %in% "SALxNCO" ~ 2
    , family %in% "SALxHUA" ~ 3
  ), .after = family) %>% 
  merge(., pheno, by.x = "geno", by.y = "line")

rsl <- (length(gwsdt) - 11):length(gwsdt) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- gwsdt[x]
  
  nam_gwas = gwas(y = trait
                , gen = gwsdt %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SNP_"))
                , fam = gwsdt$fam
                , chr = chr
                )
  
  plot(nam_gwas, alpha = 0.05/nrow(info)
         , main = names(trait)
         ) %>% print
  
  nam_gwas$PolyTest %>% mutate(trait = names(trait)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
}) 

gwas_sal_nam <- rsl %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, pval, trait) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = pval) %>% 
  base::merge(info, ., by = "ID") %>% 
  arrange(rowid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid, REF:FILTER))
```

## KANCOLLA NAM

```{r}

  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>%

  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>%
```

### Cargar datos y preparar estructuras

```{python}
#Datos
os.getcwd()
Dir_DataSet =  os.path.normpath(os.path.join(Dir,'/dat-PP/'))
Folds_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(Dir_DataSet,'10Folds_df.csv'))
Folds_df.head()
DataSets =  ['Wheat_'+str(j+1)+'_AL' for j in range(6)]
DataSets
for dn in range(1,6+1):  # To run the deep learning models on the first 6 datasets
    #dn = 2
    DataNumber = dn-1
    Dir_dat = os.path.join(Dir_DataSet,DataSets[DataNumber]+'.RData')
    Dir_dat = ''.join(Dir_dat)
    OD = pyreadr.read_r(Dir_dat) 
    print(OD.keys())
    Pheno =  OD['Pheno']
    Pheno = Pheno.rename(columns={'Line':'GID'})
    Pheno.head()
    list(Pheno.columns)
    Traits = ["GY"]#,'T2','T3','T4' ]#colnames(Pheno)[4:7]
    for t in range(1,2):  
        print('DataSet',DataSets[DataNumber])
        #Response
        y = Pheno[Traits[t-1]]
        Pos_NA = np.where(y.isna())
        y =  y.to_numpy(copy=True)
        y = y.astype(float)
        y = np.reshape(y,(len(y),1))    
   
        #Markers
        XM = OD['Markers']
        np.shape(XM)
        print(XM.iloc[:,0:5].head(5))
        #XM.index = pd.RangeIndex(0,np.shape(XM)[0],1)
        XM =  XM.apply(np.round)
        XM.nunique().describe()
        np.unique(np.unique(XM,axis=1))
        print('Marker Data',np.shape(XM))
        #XM = tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(y=XM,num_classes=2)
        #np.shape(XM)#Para CNN
        Scaler_Markers = StandardScaler()#with_mean=False)
        XM = Scaler_Markers.fit_transform(XM)#xL_tr
        #print(Scaler_Markers.mean_)
        np.min(np.sqrt(Scaler_Markers.var_))
    
        G = np.matmul(XM,np.transpose(XM))/np.shape(XM)[1]
        G = pd.DataFrame(G)
        G5  =  XR2_f(G)
        np.shape(G5)
        Order = OD['Markers'].index # Define el orden deseado de las categorías
        #Convierte la columna 'GID' en una categoría ordenada
        Pheno['GID'] = pd.Categorical(Pheno['GID'], categories=Order, ordered=True)
        ZL = pd.get_dummies(Pheno['GID'],columns=['GID'])
        np.mean(ZL.columns==OD['Markers'].index)
        XL = np.matmul(ZL,G5[Match_f(ZL.columns,OD['Markers'].index),:])#
        XL = XL.to_numpy()
        ZL =  None   
        GIDs = Pheno['GID'].unique()
        Fold_df =  Folds_df[Folds_df['DataSet']==DataSets[DataNumber]]
        Fold_df.head()
        K = len(Fold_df['Fold'].unique())        
        x_ls_all = [XL]#
        Params = {}
        Hypers_Fixed = {'Epochs': 128,'Batch_size':len(y),'Seed':42,'Iters':250,
                        'IK': 10,'Use':10} 
        Device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')# Definir el dispositivo (GPU si está disponible, de lo contrario CPU)
        Hypers_Fixed['Device'] =  Device#DataNumber = dn-1
        Dir_Outs0 = os.path.join(Dir,'Outs-Mod-v8_0-Shared'+'-Iters-'+str(Hypers_Fixed['Iters']),DataSets[dn-1])#+str(Hypers_Fixed['IK'])+'Use'+str(Hypers_Fixed['Use']))#+'-Trait'+Traits[t-1])+'-Iters-'+str(Hypers_Fixed['Iters']))
        if not os.path.exists(Dir_Outs0):
            os.makedirs(Dir_Outs0, exist_ok=True)#mkdir(Dir_Outs0)
        else:
            print(f"El directorio '{Dir_Outs0}' ya existe.")
        for k in range(1,K+1):
            Fold = np.repeat(100,len(y))
            Fold[Fold_df['Pos_tst'][Fold_df['Fold']==k].to_numpy()-1] = k#
            np.mean(Fold==k)
            x_ls_tr, y_tr = [x_ls_all[m][Fold!=k,:] for m in range(len(x_ls_all))], y[Fold!=k]
            Scaler_y = StandardScaler()
            y_tr = Scaler_y.fit_transform(y_tr)
            dat_tr = {'x_ls_tr':x_ls_tr,'y_tr':y_tr}        
            Hypers_Fixed['IFold'] = SIFold(dat_tr['y_tr'], K= Hypers_Fixed['IK'], nq=10, random_state=Hypers_Fixed['Seed'])   
            Time = time.time()
            def f_O(**kwargs):#nHL1,Units1,nHL2,Units2,nHLB2,UnitsB2,ll,llr):# nHL3,Units3 and (2**nHL3<=Units3)
                nHL1, Units1 = kwargs['nHL1'],kwargs['Units1']#,kwargs['nHL2'] ,kwargs['Units2']  
                #nHLB2, UnitsB2 = kwargs['nHLB2'],kwargs['UnitsB2']
                ll,llr, lwd = kwargs['ll'], kwargs['llr'],kwargs['lwd']#,kwargs['llo']]
                Ind = np.all(2**nHL1<=Units1)# and 2**nHL2<=Units2 and 2**nHLB2<=UnitsB2)
                if Ind:
                    nHLs, Units = [nHL1], [Units1]#nHL3
                    nHL_ls, Units = [int(nHLs[j]) for j in range(len(nHLs))], [int(Units[j]) for j in range(len(nHLs))]
                    Units_ls = [[ int(Units[m]/(2**j)) for j in range(nHL_ls[m]) ]   for m in range(len(x_ls_all))]
                    #nHLB2 =  int(1)
                    #UnitsB2_ls = []# int(UnitsB2/(2**j)) for j in range(nHLB2)]            
                    Hypers_R = {'UnitsB1_lsls':Units_ls,#'UnitsB2_ls':UnitsB2_ls,
                                'l':np.exp(ll),'lr':np.exp(llr),'wd':np.exp(lwd)}
                    Hypers_p = {**Hypers_Fixed,**Hypers_R}#{**Hypers_a,**{'wd':np.exp(lwd),'Pat':int(Pat)}}
                    #print(Hypers_p) Hypers_Fixed
                    Val_metric = IKFCV_f(dat_tr,Hypers_p,IK = Hypers_Fixed['IK'],
                                         Use = Hypers_Fixed['Use'],PlotTraining=False)
                    MSEP_Val = np.mean(Val_metric['Val_metric'])#-sigma**2
                    if np.isnan(MSEP_Val) or np.isinf(MSEP_Val) or MSEP_Val> np.var(y_tr)*1000:
                        MSEP_Val = np.var(y_tr)*1000#-1e5
                    return -MSEP_Val
                else:
                    #print('Units1',Units1,'nHL1',nHL1)
                    return -np.var(y_tr)*1000#-1e5
            Bounds = {'nHL1':[1,4],#'nHL2':[1,5],# 'nHL3':[1,4],
                      'Units1':[64,512],#'Units2':[32,1032],# 'Units2':(8,128),
                      #'nHLB2':[1,3], #'UnitsB2':[8,128],
                     'll':[np.log(np.e**- 10),np.log(np.e**-1)],
                     'llr':[np.log(np.e**-10),np.log(np.e**-0)],#,'Pat':(1,128)}
                     'lwd':[np.log(1-0.95),np.log(1-0.05)]}#Entre 5 y 95% se reduce el lr,'ll2':[np.log(1e-6),np.log(1e-1)],
                     #'llo':[np.log(1e-6),np.log(1e-1)],'llr':[np.log(1e-6),np.log(1e-1)],
                     
            BO = BayesianOptimization(f=f_O,pbounds=Bounds,random_state=50,verbose=1)
            #xi=0.01 # Mayor explotación (default), xi=0.1# Balance entre exploración y explotación
            #xi=1.0# Alta exploración, xi=2.0# Exploración muy alta
            #kappa=0.01#Baja exploración, kappa=2.576)  # Balance entre exploración y explotación (default)
            #kappa=10 #alta exploración,  kappa=20  # Exploración muy alta
            #Utility = UtilityFunction(kind="pi", xi=0.01)  # Probability of Improvement (PI), xi controla la exploración
            xi = 0.1#0.01, 1
            Utility = UtilityFunction(kind="ei", xi=xi)  # Expected Improvement (EI), valores más altos de xi fomentan la exploración
            #Utility = UtilityFunction(kind="ucb", kappa=2.576)  # Upper Confidence Bound (UCB), kappa controla la exploración
            BO.maximize(init_points=5, n_iter=Hypers_Fixed['Iters'],  acquisition_function = Utility)# Por defecto usa Expected Improvement (EI)
            #BO.maximize(init_points=5, n_iter=Hypers_Fixed['Iters'])# Por defecto usa Expected Improvement (EI)
            print(BO.max)
            #BO.set_bounds(new_bounds=Bounds)
            #BO.maximize(init_points=1, n_iter=Iters)
            #Optimal parameters >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
            Pars_O = BO.max['params']
            #print(Pars_O)
            nHLs, Units, l =  [], [], []
            for i in range(len(x_ls_all)):#Cambiar 6 por nI+1 para cuando son nI inputs
                nHLs.append(int(Pars_O[''.join(['nHL',str(i+1)])]))
                Units.append(int(Pars_O[''.join(['Units',str(i+1)])]))
                #l.append(np.exp(Pars_O['ll'+str(i+1)]))
            l = np.exp(Pars_O['ll'])
            nHL_ls, Units = [int(nHLs[j]) for j in range(len(nHLs))], [int(Units[j]) for j in range(len(nHLs))]
            Units_ls = [[ int(Units[m]/(2**j)) for j in range(nHL_ls[m]) ]   for m in range(len(x_ls_all))]
            #nHLB2 =  int(Pars_O['nHLB2'])
            #UnitsB2_ls = []#[int(Pars_O['UnitsB2']/(2**j)) for j in range(nHLB2)]
            Hypers_R_O = {'UnitsB1_lsls':Units_ls,#'UnitsB2_ls':UnitsB2_ls,
                        'l':l,'lr':np.exp(Pars_O['llr']),'wd':np.exp(Pars_O['lwd'])}
            Params_O = {**Hypers_Fixed,**Hypers_R_O}#{**Hypers_a,**{'wd':np.exp(lwd),'Pat':int(Pat)}}
            Params_O
            
            #Prediction of tst >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
            yp_tst  =  np.zeros((np.sum(Fold==k),1))#0*y_tst
            y_tst, x_ls_tst = y[Fold==k], [x_ls_all[m][Fold==k,:] for m in range(len(x_ls_all))]
            x_ls_tst = [torch.from_numpy(arr) for arr in x_ls_tst]
            x_ls_tst =  [x_ls_tst[m].to(torch.float32) for m in range(len(x_ls_all))]
            if torch.cuda.is_available():
                x_ls_tst = [tensor.to(Params_O['Device']) for tensor in x_ls_tst]
            for ik in range(1,Hypers_Fixed['Use']+1):
                DModel_O = MMMLP(Params_O, dat_tr)# Definir el modelo                
                Pos_itr = Hypers_Fixed['IFold'] != ik #Notar que es un arreglo. Pos_itr = [IFold[j] != ik for j in range(len(IFold))]
                #print(Pos_itr)
                DModel_O.fit(Pos_itr=Pos_itr, PlotTraining=False) # Entrenar el modelo                
                yp_tst_ik =  DModel_O.Model(x_ls_tst)#Scaler_y.inverse_transform(FM_O_ls['Model'].predict(x_ls_tst,verbose=0))# flatten()
                if torch.cuda.is_available():
                    yp_tst_ik = yp_tst_ik.cpu()
                yp_tst = yp_tst +  Scaler_y.inverse_transform(yp_tst_ik.detach().numpy())
            yp_tst = yp_tst/Hypers_Fixed['Use']
            # DModel_O = MMMLP(Params_O, dat)# Definir el modelo        
            # DModel_O.fit(Pos_itr=None, PlotTraining=True)# Entrenar el modelo        
            # yp_tst = DModel_O.Model(x_ls_tst)# Entrenar el modelo 
            # yp_tst =  yp_tst.cpu().detach().numpy()#[:,0] 
            #fig, ax = plt.subplots(nrows=1, ncols=1, figsize=(6, 6))
            ##plt.scatter(y_tst,yp_tst,c='blue',s=5)
            #ax.scatter(y_tst,yp_tst,c='blue',s=5)
            #abline_plot(intercept=0, slope=1, ax=ax)
            #plt.show()
            Time = time.time()-Time
            np.mean((y_tst-yp_tst)**2)
            #Pos_Top tst
            #Matching_Top = np.mean(yp_tst>np.quantile(y[Fold!=k],0.80))
            PosTop_tst, PosTop_tstp = np.where(y_tst>np.quantile(y_tst,0.8))[0], np.where(yp_tst>np.quantile(yp_tst,0.8))[0]
            GIDTop_tst = GIDs[Fold==k][PosTop_tst]
            # #Matching_Top = np.mean([GIDs[Fold==k][i] in GIDTop_tst for i in range(np.sum(Fold==k))])# No tiene sentido
            Id_df = {'Iters':Hypers_Fixed['Iters'],
                     'Batch_size':Hypers_Fixed['Batch_size'],'GPU':str(GPU),
                     'AF':'EI','Xi':xi,'Folds':K,'IKUsed':str(Hypers_Fixed['IK'])+'Used'+str(Hypers_Fixed['Use']),
                     'DataSet':DataSets[DataNumber], 'Trait':Traits[t-1]}
            Matching_Top = np.mean([GIDs[Fold==k][PosTop_tstp][i] in GIDTop_tst for i in range(len(PosTop_tstp))])
            Tab_k = pd.DataFrame({**Id_df,**{'Fold':k,'Env':'NA', 'Cor':[np.corrcoef(y_tst[:,0],yp_tst[:,0])[0,1]],
                                  'MSE':[np.mean((y_tst-yp_tst)**2)],
                                  'NRMSE':[np.sqrt(np.mean((y_tst-yp_tst)**2))/np.mean(y_tst)],'Time':Time/3600,
                                  'Matching':Matching_Top}})
            
            #Save Preds                             
            Dir_Outs =  os.path.join(Dir_Outs0,'Preds-'+Predictor+'-Trait-'+str(Traits[t-1])+'.csv')
            df_Preds = pd.DataFrame({**Id_df,**{'Env':'NA',#dat_F.loc[np.where(Fold==k)]['Env'],
                                      'Fold':k,'y':y_tst[:,0],'yp':yp_tst[:,0]}})
            df_Preds.reset_index(inplace=True)
            #Tab_k2 = Metrics_df(df_Preds,Grp='Env')
            #Tab_k2.insert(0, 'Fold', k)
            if not os.path.exists(Dir_Outs):            
                df_Preds.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)
            else:
                Existing_file =  pd.read_csv(Dir_Outs)
                df_Preds = pd.concat([Existing_file,df_Preds], ignore_index=True)
                df_Preds.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)        
            #Save Tb-Smm
            Dir_Outs =  os.path.join(Dir_Outs0,'Tab-Smm-'+Predictor+'-Trait-'+str(Traits[t-1])+'.csv')    
            #Tab_k =  pd.concat([Tab_k,Tab_k2])
            if not os.path.exists(Dir_Outs):                        
                Tab_k.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)
            else:
                Existing_file =  pd.read_csv(Dir_Outs)
                Tab_k = pd.concat([Existing_file,Tab_k], ignore_index=True)
                Tab_k.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)       
            #Save Hypers
            Dir_Outs =  os.path.join(Dir_Outs0,'Hypers-'+Predictor+'-Trait-'+str(Traits[t-1])+'.csv')
            Hyper_df_k = pd.DataFrame(BO.max)
            Hyper_df_k['Parameter'], Hyper_df_k['Fold'] = Hyper_df_k.index, k
            Hyper_df_k
            if not os.path.exists(Dir_Outs):
                Hyper_df_k.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)
            else:
                Hyper_df =  pd.read_csv(Dir_Outs)
                Hyper_df_k = pd.concat([Hyper_df,Hyper_df_k], ignore_index=True)
                Hyper_df_k.to_csv(Dir_Outs,index=False)   
            
            print('Fold',k)
```

# LD decay

- https://speciationgenomics.github.io/ld_decay/

```{bash}
VCF=genetics/pop_SAL.vcf

plink1 --vcf $VCF --double-id --allow-extra-chr \
--set-missing-var-ids @:# \
--thin 0.1 --r2 gz --ld-window 100 --ld-window-kb 5 \
--ld-window-r2 0 \
--out genetics/ld_quinoa
```

```{r}
ld <- read.table("genetics/ld_quinoa.ld.gz", header=TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(distance = BP_B - BP_A)

ggplot(ld, aes(x= distance, y = R2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(x="Distance (bp)", y="LD (r²)", title="LD Decay Plot")


```

```{bash}
plink1 --vcf genetics/pop_SAL.vcf --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-r2 0 --r2 --out genetics/ld_quinoa --allow-extra-chr
```

